caption:
AMD stock jumped 5.3% to $530.14 on Wednesday while Nvidia stock fell 2.9% to $150.96, its lowest close since June 2025, the day after Nvidia's record $115.8B quarter.
Since Nov 6, Nvidia is down 19.1% and AMD up 18.1%, even though Nvidia trades at 9.7x expected earnings and AMD at 33.1x. AMD also closed its $2.9B Taalas inference-chip deal.
